title: Portal surface: signed web bundles in the Petal Portal, fe-portal custom protocol, host-brokered IPC, repository nodes, dedicated QA lane
description: Web bundles (dashboards, documentation sites, repository-node code bundles) become signed packages in the sealed .hexon Plugin family. They render in the existing Petal Portal webview from the local blob store, through a new fe-portal custom protocol with per-package origins, a host-authored CSP and a navigation allowlist consulted in both navigation layers. Each peer's extension governance admits a bundle before it gets a typed IPC bridge. That bridge is a consumer and producer on the integration bus of extension_platform_20261107: subscriptions to host/node-changes, host/readings and host/query, plus actions judged as the installing identity at write time. Unsigned or unadmitted bundles render in a no-IPC static sandbox, and replicated rows never auto-execute. A dedicated QA lane covers headless decision tables, native WebView2 fixed operations and a simulator portal probe. Static export for the web is a later phase. The track ships no charting or dashboard builder (product.md non-goal); this repo only describes open capability.

2026-11-07: FEASIBILITY (spec §8). Five constraints found in the tree: (1) the Tauri commands cannot be registered, because tauri_commands.rs needs a tauri::AppHandle, there is no tauri::Builder, and wry is driven directly; the real bridge is wry with_ipc_handler plus with_asynchronous_custom_protocol, both present in the pinned wry 0.54.4. (2) The raw URL policy refuses every bundle origin in four places by design, so admission must be by exact origin match, never by relaxing the policy. (3) Both scene-asset gates are glTF-only (scene_asset_transfer.rs:72-77, scene_asset.rs:94-112), so bundles cannot replicate until a cross-track MIME branch lands. (4) No readings push source exists in fe-api; the sibling's host/readings covers it. (5) wry has no per-origin storage clear (clear_all_browsing_data clears every origin), so the WebView2 DevTools protocol is spike SP-6.

2026-11-07: EVIDENCE CORRECTIONS (spec §12). There is no crate-root fe-webview/AGENTS.md (the crate doc is fe-webview/src/AGENTS.md). fe-ui/src/portal.rs does not exist (the module is fe-ui/src/portal/mod.rs; live code is actions/portal.rs and panels/portal_toolbar.rs). fixture_surface/fixture_stream are fixed-script native surfaces inside TauriBackend on captured Windows hosts, not fake backends. application/x-fe-directory is a 501 placeholder, not a working container. petal_portal's Selected/ModelUrlMeta activation has no producer in the app.

2026-11-07: SIBLING ALIGNMENT. The extension_platform_20261107 draft (uncommitted at authoring) already defines host/query, host/readings and host/node-changes (R13); extension streams, commands and hooks with caller kind 'portal' (R14); 'Portal IPC ... is one more client of the same broker' (R15); kill-switch layers (R23); host-stamped provenance (R24); and 'rich UI belongs to portals' (OD-E8). This track cites those ids and must re-verify them once the sibling commits. Its interval-based host/query (re-run at >= 1 s) is raised as OD-3, not redefined here.

tripwires: fe_runtime::portal_url::is_url_allowed is never relaxed. Bundle origins are admitted only by exact match against the live mount table, in BOTH navigation layers (decide_navigation and qa_navigation::enforce)
replicated rows never auto-execute: no mount without an explicit local Open, and no IPC without a local Admitted record
the IPC handler authorizes the sender origin and document generation before decoding anything; unauthorized senders get no reply
host-drawn chrome is the only trust indicator; admission state is never derived from page content
QA routes run only fixed host-owned scripts and numbered slots; no caller-supplied JavaScript, selectors or URLs
bundle members are never served inline from the fe-api origin; attachment + nosniff stay on every REST blob response
script-src 'self' only, never 'unsafe-eval'; service-worker script requests are refused at the protocol handler
no timer polling for node/readings subscriptions (QA-0125); portal writes stay at or below 2/s per bundle (single-peer DB-thread ceiling is about 8 writes/s)
no charting, report-layout or dashboard-builder code; fixture dashboards live only under tools/qa/portal/bundles
PUBLIC repo: no business logic, never name private tracks, leak grep before every commit
S2's owns list is provisional until extension_platform_20261107 commits its spec and posts its integration-bus contract milestone; re-run the slice grill then
agents never run cargo while .omc/state/build-gate.json has cargo_allowed=false; one serial gate per wave, posted as 'building EXT-PORTAL <what>' on the bus first
